reasoning: The constraints require the graph to consist solely of exactly two disjoint cliques of size 3, covering all vertices. This would account for only 6 vertices, but the problem demands a graph with 15 vertices. Hence no graph can satisfy all given conditions.
cot_trace: We need graph with 15 vertices, but condition says consists of exactly 2 vertex-disjoint cliques of size 3 (every vertex belongs to one of these cliques, and the only edges are within these cliques). That would cover only 6 vertices, not 15. Also says every vertex belongs to one of these cliques, impossible for 15 vertices. So UNSAT.
